description: Land Acquisition - Galaha, Delthota D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that a particular parcel of land (0.0824 Hectare in Galaha village) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the primary focus is on land acquisition procedures and property description, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
